description: Image Description: The image shows a white ceramic bidet installed against a dark brown wall. It features a chrome faucet with a single lever for controlling water flow. The bidet has a standard oval shape with a drain at the bottom and a small overflow opening near the top. To the left of the bidet, there is a brown plastic wastebasket placed on the floor. The surrounding area appears to be part of a bathroom, with a tiled floor visible underneath the bidet.
